```yaml
name: Backend Required Quality Gates

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Backend quality gate – runs only when backend files change
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  backend:
    name: Backend Quality Gate
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && (contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'backend') || contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'api')) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: getsentry/action-setup-venv@5a80476d175edf56cb205b08bc58986fa99d1725
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache-dependency-path: '**/requirements.txt'
          venv-dir: .venv
          install-cmd: pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run backend tests
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest -q -c /dev/null --confcutdir=tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -o cache_dir=/tmp/pytest-cache-ci tldw_Server_API/tests/CI

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: backend-test-results
          path: tldw_Server_API/tests/CI

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # No‑op job to keep required checks green when only non‑backend files change
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  backend-noop:
    name: Backend No‑Op
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && !(contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'backend') || contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'api')) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Pass
        run: echo "No backend changes – passing no‑op."

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security gate – runs only when security‑related files change
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  security:
    name: Security Gate
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && (contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'security') || contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'bandit')) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: getsentry/action-setup-venv@5a80476d175edf56cb205b08bc58986fa99d1725
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache-dependency-path: '**/requirements.txt'
          venv-dir: .venv
          install-cmd: pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run Bandit
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m bandit -r tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -s B101 -f json -o /tmp/bandit_ci_sha_pin.json

      - name: Upload Bandit report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bandit-report
          path: /tmp/bandit_ci_sha_pin.json

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # No‑op job for security gate when irrelevant files change
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  security-noop:
    name: Security No‑Op
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && !(contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'security') || contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'bandit')) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Pass
        run: echo "No security changes – passing no‑op."

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Frontend quality gate – always required
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  frontend:
    name: Frontend Quality Gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test -- --coverage

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # End‑to‑end tests – always required
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  e2e:
    name: E2E Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: getsentry/action-setup-venv@5a80476d175edf56cb205b08bc58986fa99d1725
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache-dependency-path: '**/requirements.txt'
          venv-dir: .venv
          install-cmd: pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run e2e tests
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest -q -c /dev/null --confcutdir=tldw_Server_API/tests/e2e -o cache_dir=/tmp/pytest-cache-e2e tldw_Server_API/tests/e2e

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Coverage gate – always required
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  coverage:
    name: Coverage Report
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: getsentry/action-setup-venv@5a80476d175edf56cb205b08bc58986fa99d1725
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache-dependency-path: '**/requirements.txt'
          venv-dir: .venv
          install-cmd: pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run tests with coverage
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=tldw_Server_API --cov-report=xml

      - name: Upload coverage report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-report
          path: coverage.xml

      - name: Publish coverage to Codecov
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: coverage.xml
